slice: The Agents window has no bottom panel
method: new desktop patch 0026 + transpile + CDP on the running Agents window (DOM measurement and a real cmd+J key event)

problem.symptom: the terminal is an Apps panel tab on the right, but the Agents window still had a bottom panel: cmd+J opened it as an empty strip with Output and Terminal in it
problem.measured: before the change, .part.panel had height 0 on load and 296 after cmd+J

change.patch: 0026-caret-agents-no-bottom-panel.patch touches only src/vs/sessions/browser/workbench.ts: _effectiveVisible never reports the panel as visible, setPanelHidden refuses to show it, and a saved "visible" is not restored on load. The part stays in the layout bookkeeping, so every other call site still resolves, and the IDE window - which has its own workbench - keeps its panel.
change.whyNotRemove: deleting the part from the grid would touch the panel node, the persisted sizes, the maximized-view path and the pane-composite service at once; refusing visibility removes the chrome without putting the layout bookkeeping in an invalid state.

verified.liveLoad: with the extension and the Apps panel in the running dev Agents window, .part.panel is height 0
verified.liveToggle: a real cmd+J key event leaves .part.panel at height 0 (it opened to 296 before the change)
verified.terminalStillWorks: opening Terminal from the Apps panel strip produced a zsh tab with a live xterm inside .caret-apps-panel, and the bottom panel stayed at 0 - also after pressing cmd+J again
